label: Golden 50
role: Accuracy check: the pipeline labels your 50 hand labeled reviews blind; code compares field by field.

label: Pilot 100
role: Required cost and runtime measurement: real cold run, then a warm rerun that must make zero new labeling calls.

label: Dev 500
role: First complete development run; instructions are checked here before scaling.

label: Budget 10,000
role: Last check of speed, failures and cost before the final run; also a 2 worker to 4 worker stop and resume.

label: Final 100,000
role: The graded run: 100,000 reviews sampled with the course's own seeded hash rule (nests the golden 50 and the 10,000 sample) plus the 13 empty texts, with a deliberate stop and resume.
